checks.name: PostgreSQL and row-level security
checks.detail: The application is using the memory/reference repository.
checks.remediation: Configure DATABASE_URL for durable multi-user operation.

checks.name: Immutable snapshot object storage
checks.detail: Write/read/delete round trip succeeded through file storage.
checks.remediation: Configure S3 or MinIO for production snapshot durability.

checks.name: Approved knowledge vector retrieval
checks.detail: DATABASE_URL is required for pgvector retrieval.
checks.remediation: Run the active vector probe and index only approved release records.

checks.name: Configurable LLM brain
checks.detail: No external or local model route is configured; deterministic mode remains available.
checks.remediation: Configure one approved provider or local OpenAI-compatible route.

checks.name: GitHub knowledge refresh
checks.remediation: Configure a read-only credential and an acceptance repository, then execute the active probe.

checks.name: External fitness-function CI loop
checks.detail: No writable fitness-test target repository is configured.
checks.remediation: Open a generated pull request in a non-production acceptance repository, execute CI and return conformance evidence to AIW.

checks.name: Enterprise OIDC identity
checks.detail: Development identity mode is active or enterprise OIDC is incomplete.
checks.remediation: Configure issuer and audience, run discovery/JWKS acceptance, then complete real sign-in and role-mapping tests.

checks.name: Runtime telemetry and conformance feed
checks.detail: No external telemetry endpoint is configured.
checks.remediation: Connect an OTLP collector and run an active synthetic-span export.

checks.name: Enterprise release signing trust
checks.detail: No enterprise release signing key is configured.
checks.remediation: Use a protected enterprise key or KMS-backed signer and independently verify the packaged release.

boundary: Configured means a code path and secret reference exist. Verified means this runtime completed the named active probe. Production accepted means every required check is verified; accountable environment sign-off and retained evidence are still required.
